# smart-immunizations-annexes

The web annexes this IG's pages load on demand (bean folio-assistant-fm9n; owner, 2026-10-10, option 2a: the data dictionary in the knowledge graph, loaded dynamically, not the full workbook). `annexes.json` (`ig-annexes/v1`) puts `../web-annexes/dak-data-dictionary.json` on `dictionary.md`, showing six columns and opening the rest per row; and `personas-swimlanes.md` on `personas.md` and `processes-swimlanes.md` on `business-processes.md` (litlfred/aai-programme#28, bean folio-assistant-cydz; owner, 2026-10-10, option 1a: "personas/roles should cross link to swimlane in process"), appended to their pages as written: each persona with the processes whose swimlanes name it, and each process figure's lanes with the persona each is or why it is not one. Those two are written by smart-base's `dak-swimlanes.ts` from `input/pagecontent/personas.md`, the business-process figures and `input/business-processes/swimlanes.json`: regenerate them, never edit them; its QA record goes to `test/results/` on the qa branch, not here. fhir-harness's IG site build finds it through this `ig-annex` declaration, both `stage-ig-sites` for an index and `ig-repo-site.ts compose` for this repository's own site. It is a directory of its own, not `fhir-artifact-index/`, because an IG repository commits no artefact index (fhir-harness#124; owner, 2026-10-24, option B).

Part of [WHO SMART Guidelines — Immunizations](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-immunizations-annexes`, holding `ig-annex`.
